method: Project roots walked for manifests and distinctive filenames. Nested node_modules, dist, vendor, plugins, and build output were skipped. Compass config.rb and Capistrano-only Gemfiles were not counted as Ruby products. Python under cdk/ or scripts/ was not counted as a product stack. Archives under Engineering/Clients were listed, not extracted. Other zips inside already indexed trees (uploads, plugin bundles, database dumps) were not treated as separate projects.
